influences.name: George Martin
influences.context: Jay has become that [for us]. And him and I have been working very close on this record. I'll tell you, man, Jay's done the last few ANTHRAX records, and he's become… We talked about [legendary THE BEATLES producer] George Martin before, and Jay has become that [for us].

influences.name: Charlie Benante
influences.context: Charlie and I grew up together, as you know, in the same house. He very much started me on music and he was always playing music. He was always a great drummer. He played guitar before I even played guitar or bass. So he started me on it, then we went our separate ways and I went to bass. He's actually the one who told me to switch because I was playing the bass parts on guitar.

influences.name: Lemmy
influences.context: I moved to L.A. and the only thing that was left was Lemmy at the Rainbow. That was the only truth to what I believed what was happening in Los Angeles.

influences.name: Jonny Z
influences.context: Yet Jonny Z from Megaforce Records, he founded Anthrax and Metallica, he said: "Manowar is the first power metal band."
